item.title: Implement retry_budget.py per SPEC.md with focused tests
item.brief:
Operator request (authenticated inbox message, verbatim): "Implement `retry_budget.py` according to `SPEC.md`. Preserve the documented API, handle every specified error and boundary case, and add focused tests. The existing tests cover basics only. Use the Python standard library and commit your work."

Context: the repository root holds SPEC.md (the authoritative spec), retry_budget.py (existing stub or partial implementation) and test_retry_budget.py (existing basic tests). Read SPEC.md first and treat it as the contract.

Goal: retry_budget.py implements every behaviour, error case and boundary case in SPEC.md, keeping the documented public API unchanged.

Acceptance criteria:
- Every API item documented in SPEC.md exists with the documented signature and behaviour.
- Every error case in SPEC.md raises the documented exception or error value; no silent failures.
- Every boundary case in SPEC.md is covered by a test.
- Keep existing tests passing; add focused tests in test_retry_budget.py for the error and boundary cases not already covered.
- Python standard library only; no new dependencies.
- Code follows the repository's conventions; functions stay small and inputs are validated at the boundary.
- Run the test suite and report its exact result.
- Commit the work on the local branch with a clear message. Do not push. Commit as the configured git user, with no tool or AI attribution in the message.

pr.body: Approach: retry_delay in retry_budget.py. _require_int validates every argument as a built-in int (rejects bool, float, int subclasses) with a minimum, before any early return. _backoff returns 0 when base or cap is 0, and returns cap without building 2**k once k >= cap.bit_length(). Retry-After is max(backoff, retry_after_ms) and is not capped. Returns None when attempt >= max_attempts or elapsed+delay >= budget_ms. Files: retry_budget.py, test_retry_budget.py (19 new tests). Checks: python3 -B -m unittest -> 22 tests OK. Review: one reviewer, pass, no blocking findings. Follow-up (non-blocking): pin the saturation threshold at attempt-1 == cap.bit_length().
pr.summary: made retry_delay follow SPEC.md. now validates all args, caps backoff with saturation, applies Retry-After as uncapped floor, enforces exclusive budget. before: NotImplementedError stub, now: 22 passing tests
